name: stamp_badge
description: A seal stamped onto the screen: a small line over a big bordered stamp that hits from far too big, shakes and throws dust, then an optional short line with an icon rises under it. For trust: an official permit, a licence, a certificate, a guarantee, being the first or the only one.

label.description: Optional: the small line over the stamp, e.g. "META'DAN". Written in capitals by the code.

stamp.description: The stamp's words, e.g. 'RASMIY RUXSAT', 'KAFOLAT 2 YIL'. Written in capitals by the code.

sub.description: Optional: the line that rises under it, e.g. "O'zbekistonda birinchi".

icon.description: Optional: the drawing before that line, e.g. medal.

beats.hit: The word the stamp hits on.
beats.rise: The word the line under it rises on.
